node.statement: RK — THE RIGIDITY KERNEL (imported schema, kernel K2 of the kernel-basis program; WP0 2026-07-10; source: rigidity_kernel.md @ codex/f3-net-absorption c1cb7bd1; full import package with term resolutions, provenance ledger, and nine flagged gaps in node notes). SETTING: row RS_q(H_n,k) on a 2-power (sub)group domain, scale M over the quotient lattice of n (subgroups K_M plus 'dihedral composites' — UNDEFINED in source, pending pin; intended twin-coset window scales per qa21/E25/E26); FM(A) = C(n,n-A) q^{1-(A-k)}; operating point FM-SUPPRESSED when n^B FM(A) < the integer allowance (source ambiguous between allowance 1 and B* = floor(q_line/2^128); exponent B unpinned). SCHEMA: at any FM-suppressed point, every AGREEMENT OBJECT (schema variable — per face: aligned support / deeply-agreeing codeword / rank-deficient configuration / concurrency point) either (i) lies in the PAID TAXONOMY (tangent/deep-divisor; multiplicative pullback g(X^M'); dihedral pullback X^e g(X^M'+X^-M'); extension-type — no positive in-branch definition) or (ii) belongs to a stabilizer-primitive remainder of size <= n^{B_RK} FM, uniformly in the fixed word/pair (TR-style quantifier order) and jointly across isotypic components (#212 tower product, PROVED). PROVED-INSTANCE BOX (label-checked): thm:deep-mca (v12:4504); v12 pincer (one CA import); flats dim 1/2/fixed-d (main PR #182 Lemmas 3/6+6A/7 — incidence-shaped, NOT FM-shaped: conversion unstated, catch-#23-shaped risk); MDS-dual (qf12_qf13 sect. 6); average-case pair ledger c(s,t) = min(s,t-1) (qx13; verifier independently replayed 2026-07-10: 164/164 PASS); #152 t=2 local; #212 cross-character product; qx11 top-core double count (CONDITIONAL on open exchange_ledger_gen_t). CLAIMED CONSUMPTION MAPS — UNREPLAYED, recorded as claims only (program anti-goal: no red ambers on an unreplayed map): Face 1 -> gap1/Conjecture TR (axes Q,T,J; replay in WP3/WP4 wiring); Face 2 -> dli lane/Conjecture F residue (axes D,Q; WP4); Face 3 -> xr_smallcore_spread_count (axis Q + geometry; WP2); Face 4 -> worst_word pricing (axes R,Q; pigeonhole measured NOT to engage at toy FM corridors — e27; WP7). NON-CLAIMS: not a theorem; no proved instance crosses the frontier axes (R/D/Q/T/J); the faces do not follow from RK as stated until replayed; 'dihedral composites'/'extension-type'/(B, allowance) are import-time gaps; no coset-domain or mixed-radix generality; toy censuses (FM = Theta(1)) do not witness prize-scale suppression; axis Q is the inverse-theorem barrier (classification, not counting). M2 IDENTIFICATION (KB log #4): shared_census_kernel is RK's CENSUS SUB-SCHEMA (objects = census fibers; sub-balance <=> FM-suppressed at allowance 1; paid families -> clause (i) with quotient pullbacks = multiplicative class and toral/norm-kernel families = extension-type — PINNING GAP 4 with a positive definition from f3_h3_char0_classification). RK's proved-instance box GROWS: the h=2 shallow collision theorem (Heath-Brown--Konyagin) and the h=3 char-0 classification are RK-instance theorems outside the original box. RK-broad objects (rank-loss/concurrency, WP2 step 5e) remain beyond SCK. See notes/kernel_basis/M2_SCK_AS_RK.md.
